personal.name: Swarnika Somvanshi
personal.title: Backend Engineer
personal.bio: Backend systems built from the protocol up: an HTTP/1.1 server on raw Java sockets, a search typeahead service, and an API gateway on PostgreSQL and Redis, each with tests and reproducible benchmarks. Open source contributor in the freeCodeCamp x NHCarrigan cohort.

services.title: REST APIs & Backend Services
services.description: APIs with clear contracts, validation, auth and tests, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis.

services.title: Full-Stack Systems (React / FastAPI)
services.description: End-to-end web applications from responsive frontends to high-throughput backend APIs with clean architecture.

services.title: Zero-Knowledge & Privacy Tech
services.description: Privacy-first browser extensions and encrypted knowledge tools that keep user data local and secure.

services.title: Browser Agents & Multithreaded TCP
services.description: Autonomous browser automation agents and low-level RFC-compliant TCP servers built from scratch in Java.

projects.title: HTTP/1.1 Server
projects.description: HTTP/1.1 server on raw Java sockets: bounded worker pool with 503 load shedding, keep-alive, chunked bodies, raw-socket test suite and wrk benchmarks.

projects.title: Search Typeahead
projects.description: Trie with precomputed top-K and trending decay, consistent-hash shard routing, write-behind buffer to SQLite; Jest tests and k6 load tests.

projects.title: ShieldWall Gateway
projects.description: LLM API gateway: PII masking with mid-stream restore, hashed per-project API keys, atomic Redis budget enforcement, Celery workers for logging and cost accounting.

projects.title: Smarana
projects.description: Chrome extension that embeds pages on-device and encrypts them with AES-256-GCM before syncing to a FastAPI + pgvector backend; hybrid search with Reciprocal Rank Fusion.

philosophy.title: Build Because It Annoys You
philosophy.description: The best tools are born from frustration. If something slows you down, build the fix — that instinct is what separates engineers from users.

philosophy.title: Research-First, Ship-Second
philosophy.description: Understand the problem deeply before writing a single line. Concept-driven development produces systems that actually last.

philosophy.title: Privacy as a Default
philosophy.description: User data should stay with the user. Zero-knowledge design and local-first architecture aren't features — they're table stakes.

philosophy.title: Solo Systems Thinking
philosophy.description: Building full-stack AI systems solo demands understanding every layer. That breadth is a feature, not a liability.
